tagline: STIHL equipment, service and parts for Rotorua
heroSubheading: Sales, service and repairs for your outdoor power equipment.
aboutHtml:
We're the STIHL shop in Lakelands, Rotorua. Christine Leaf runs the shop and we stock the full range of STIHL outdoor power equipment. If you need reliable equipment for your property or garden, we've got what works for Rotorua's climate.

We sell STIHL equipment, service and repair it when needed, and keep a full range of parts in stock. If something's broken or worn out, bring it in and we'll sort it out. If you're not sure what to buy, come in and talk to us. We know STIHL inside out and we know what locals actually need.

Come and see us. We're open Monday to Friday 8am to 5:30pm, Saturday 9am to 3pm, and Sunday 10am to 2pm.
